fact: CAFI managing director Chaba Mokuku writes that the Lesotho National Single Window, run by Revenue Services Lesotho, lets traders file import, export and transit documents through one online entry point, with twelve agencies connected.

Lesotho launched its National Single Window on 24 August 2026, where traders submit certificate, licence and permit applications for imports, exports and transit, with 12 other agencies and 88 processes automated, per Revenue Services Lesotho and CAFI.
The Lesotho National Single Window is linked to ASYCUDA World for customs declarations, per the report of the launch.

CAFI managing director Chaba Mokuku says the government is working with South Africa to remodel border infrastructure and install digital systems, including enhanced immigration and customs management tools.
system: customs management tools at the border
